Of the 53 remaining items, the best question is one that splits them close to half and half.

"Can you hold it in one hand?" looks promising. Items that fit in one hand: ball, book, bread, camera, candle, chocolate, clock, coin, glasses, hammer, ice cream, key, knife, light bulb, mirror, mug, paper, pencil, phone, scissors, shoe, toothbrush, towel, teddy bear, and possibly a few more. That is roughly 25 of 53, which is close to even.
